title: Did you hear?
hint: Take a news card and flip a coin: do you both know it, or is it news to B? A starts, B replies. Swap.

answers.S: Heads: you BOTH know it → B shares a feeling with a tag ↘, A agrees.
answers.N: Tails: it's news to B → B reacts and asks a question.

intro.title: How the game works
how: A takes a news card and reads it out.
Flip the coin. It decides: do you both already know the news?
**Heads:** you both already know it → B shares a feeling with a tag ↘, and A agrees.
**Tails:** it's news to B → B reacts and asks a question.
intro.how_end: Let's try it with one card first.

tries.after: Heads! You both already know it. Complete the replies. Then tap the yellow to check.

p: Have you seen the coffee machine? It's broken again!
. I've had three cups of tea already.

tries.after: Tails! It's news to B. Complete the replies. Then tap the yellow to check.

p: Have you seen the coffee machine? It's broken again!
No idea. It just stopped working this morning.

intro.go: Now play for real. Take turns being A: take a card and flip the coin. The two examples are at the bottom of the screen.

cards.says: Have you seen the coffee machine? It's broken again!
cards.N: No, I haven't! Oh no — **what happened?**

cards.says: Have you heard? Our favourite café has started charging for tap water!
cards.N: No! That's awful! **How much is it?**

cards.says: Did you know the new season of our favourite series is out?
cards.S: I **did**! I watched three episodes last night. It's amazing, **isn't it?**
cards.N: No way! That's great! **When did it come out?**

cards.says: Have you seen the email? Our deadline's been moved to tomorrow!
cards.N: No, I haven't! Oh no, that's awful. **Why?**

cards.says: Have you heard? My neighbour's dog has had six puppies!
cards.N: Aw, that's lovely! **Are they going to keep them all?**

cards.says: Have you seen the forecast? It's going to be sunny all weekend!
cards.S: I **have**! It's going to be lovely, **isn't it?**

items: It's so annoying, **isn't it?** – бесит, да?
It was amazing, **wasn't it?** – классно было, да?

speaking: Something you BOTH know: our lessons, a series you've both seen, something in the news. Share a feeling with a tag — your partner agrees!
Tell your partner something from your week they don't know — good or bad. They react and ask **two** questions.
Tell one piece of news twice: your partner replies both ways — first as if they already know it, then as if it's new to them.
